rationale: Re-reviewed compiler-convert after limiting what crosses into the script sandbox from a styles.config: compiler/src/config.ts (only the settings knownSettings defines are sent; a chain above a read root is decoded only when a file first needs it, through prepareConfigsFor) and compiler/src/index.ts (a loadsConfig helper shared by sourceOptions and the sandbox's prepareSource hook) only resolve config settings for sandboxed renders. convert-to-jess.ts is unchanged: the projection still comes only from context.pluginOf(document)?.jessFunctions?.() and passes unchanged to emitJess, no projection is built in the consumer, the owner is not imported, and the alternatives' anchor lines are unchanged.
